en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a tall brick lookout tower attached to or standing directly behind a villa-like building with stone lower walls and a steep tiled roof. The structure is set in a coniferous forest, with straight tree trunks framing the scene. A solitary man in early 20th‑century clothing and hat stands on a dirt path leading up to the building, holding a walking stick. The tower has narrow vertical windows and a large open viewing platform with a balustrade at the top.
